text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training was over, and as I walked down 
the hallway alone—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! Thanks for all your hard work 
today!
choice_data_list:
Thanks for your hard work, Trainer 
Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even so... so much has happened over these 
past three years, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Though brief, these three years were the 
most memorable of my entire life.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I never imagined I'd find 
friends I could open up to like this.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to learn a 
great deal. Truly, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>. Once again, I look forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As fellow Trainers, let's keep working 
hard together!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So um, if it's alright with you, maybe we 
could invite Meek and <chrname> too...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A celebration party, so to speak... 
...Err, um...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to join me for some 
karaoke? If I may be so bold, I've already 
researched a place for us!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A place with delicious food that's popular 
with young folks! I'm sure the girls will 
love it!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've got the remote controls down 
pat! Whenever you'd like to order food, 
just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I invited <chrname> and Happy Meek out, and we all 
enjoyed some singing and good food 
together.
